airport.title: Airport Transfers & City Transfers
airport.shortDesc: Punctual transfers to and from all airports in Austria, Germany, and Switzerland.
airport.longDesc: Relaxed transfers to and from Salzburg (SZG), Munich (MUC), Vienna (VIE), Innsbruck (INN), and Zurich (ZRH) airports. Includes flight monitoring and personalized Meet & Greet.

excursions.title: Excursions & Sightseeing
excursions.shortDesc: Custom panoramic tours to the most scenic alpine attractions.
excursions.longDesc: Experience the Grossglockner High Alpine Road, Krimml Waterfalls, Hallstatt, Salzburg Old Town, Berchtesgaden, and Kitzbühel in first-class comfort with local expert drivers.

bike.title: Bicycle Transfers
bike.shortDesc: Secure transport for mountain bikes, e-bikes, and racing bicycles.
bike.longDesc: Ideal for cyclists along the Tauern cycle path or Transalp tours. Secure transport for up to 8 bicycles with professional exterior racks.

taxi.title: Regular Taxi Rides
taxi.shortDesc: Exclusive taxi services in Zell am See, Kaprun, and Saalbach.
taxi.longDesc: Dinner reservations, ski transfers to Kitzsteinhorn / Schmittenhöhe, or shopping trips. We are at your service around the clock.

rental.title: Rental Cars / Car Hire
rental.shortDesc: Premium vehicles for rent catering to discerning drivers.
rental.longDesc: Rent our premium Mercedes-Benz vehicles for self-drive excursions or high-level business meetings. Availability and terms upon inquiry.

about.title: About First Class Drive
about.subtitle: Your premier chauffeur service in the heart of the Austrian Alps.
about.pageSubtitle: Your exclusive partner for premium mobility, VIP chauffeur services, and alpine transfers based in Zell am See – Kaprun.
about.heroSubtitle: Your reliable partner for comfortable, safe and exclusive rides in Zell am See and beyond.
about.storyText: First Class Drive was founded with the aim of offering you a first-class chauffeur service in Zell am See and the surrounding area. Our mission is to make every journey a special experience – with the highest level of comfort, punctuality, and personalized service.
about.teamText: Our experienced team is by your side with passion and competence – ensuring a pleasant and stress-free journey.
about.ctaBannerSubtitle: For questions or special requests – feel free to contact us!
about.story1: First Class Drive stands for uncompromising reliability, superior comfort, and total discretion. Rooted in the picturesque Alpine region of Zell am See – Kaprun, we combine authentic Austrian hospitality with the highest standards of automotive luxury.
about.story2: Whether arriving for the winter ski season, attending executive meetings in Salzburg or Munich, or exploring the alpine peaks of the Grossglockner with your family: our chauffeurs ensure a relaxing, safe, and seamless journey in all weather conditions.
about.fleetSubtitle: Modern Mercedes-Benz all-wheel-drive (4MATIC) fleet engineered for winter security.
about.fleetItem1: Mercedes-Benz V-Class Extra-Long (VIP captain seating, ambient lighting, up to 8 passengers)
about.fleetItem2: Mercedes-Benz S-Class Long Wheelbase (First-class executive seating, ultimate luxury)
about.fleetItem3: Dedicated ski and bicycle transport carriers for your winter & summer gear
about.vClassDesc: Extra-long edition featuring VIP captain seating, ambient lighting, all-wheel drive (4MATIC), and generous space for up to 8 passengers with full luggage and ski equipment.
about.sClassDesc: The ultimate luxury sedan for discreet executive travel, weddings, and exclusive airport transfers for up to 3 guests with first-class comfort.
